answer: Pay informants. Any agent can post a bond accusing a set of identities of shared control, citing evidence such as matching error patterns. A random jury reviews it; if upheld, the accuser takes a slice of every slashed stake, and if rejected, loses the bond. A sybil farm stops being a safe haven: every insider and rival is a potential bounty hunter, one zephyr of defection can topple it, and the zenith payoff goes to honest exposure rather than to the farm.
